## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(chat): conversation mentions, behind the conversation_mentions flag by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19921
* feat(automations): choose who can see an automation (OHE-4206) by @hieptl in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19893
* feat(chat): show a readable error when a budget is reached by @hieptl in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19926
* feat: View and edit an automation's key-value store by @tofarr in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19907
* feat(factories): add Factories sidebar entry with list and drill-in views by @jpshackelford in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19800
### Bug Fixes
* fix(chat): drop a Home message's pending bubble once history has moved past it (OHE-4121) by @hieptl in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19875
* fix(settings): make SettingsDropdownInput clearable by default by @SaltGardenia in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19664
* fix(conversation-overview): count diff stats from the longest common subsequence by @LeizhenZhang in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19580
### Documentation

### macOS install note

The app isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet, so macOS may call a
downloaded build *"damaged"* — it's Gatekeeper quarantine, not a bad file.
After moving the app to Applications, clear the flag once, then open normally:

```sh
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/OpenHands Agent Canvas.app"
```

Signing + notarization is tracked in OpenHands/OpenHands#16774.
